title: FMR participant same-trial observation contract

production_changes.runtime_api_surface: FMR participant read-only observation accessor only

question: Can the FMR groundwater-SWAP participant expose q/status and execution diagnostics from the exact already-executed trial, without performing another backend run or changing candidate/commit/discard semantics?

forbidden: generic groundwater_swap_transaction_participant API widening unless FMR-specific route is impossible

observation_contract.ownership: read-only view copied from participant-owned last trial_result/diagnostics/candidate state
observation_contract.backend_access: Accessor accepts no backend/executor/materializer and therefore cannot launch a new physical trial.

lifecycle_rules: A trial attempt resets the prior observation before validation/execution.
After a status-0 trial, observation is available while the candidate remains live; reading it must not alter live-candidate state or publication readiness.
After status-6 whole-window trial failure, observation remains available even though any backend candidate has been discarded; q_available is false.
Discarding a successful candidate does not change committed authority. Observation may remain as historical diagnostics until the next trial/capture/commit reset; it grants no publication authority.
Commit semantics remain controlled only by publication_ready/commit_candidate; observation data cannot commit or stage ledger mass.
Accessor is intent(in), accepts no mutable collaborator, and performs no backend call.

frozen_regression_matrix.fgc44: All 62 FGC44 G14 streaming heads across eight frozen G13 states.
frozen_regression_matrix.expected_reference: G14 fused FGC44 observations and G13 E3 decisions.
commit_subset: one ordinary successful FGC44 control head
one nontrivial successful boundary head if publication preflight remains valid
frozen_regression_matrix.failure_subset: At least one frozen status-6 head, followed by a successful independent trial from the same accepted origin.

gates: Participant status on all 62 heads equals G14.
For status-0 heads q equals G14 within 1e-18 m/s.
All execution-class fields equal G14 fused reference.
Repeated observation reads are bitwise/value stable and do not change participant candidate liveness, committed revision/time or ledger.
After status-0 observation then discard, accepted authority is unchanged.
After status-6 observation, a next admissible trial succeeds without candidate-busy leakage.
Observation before normal preflight/commit does not change the accepted state/ledger result relative to the existing baseline path.
The accessor source has no backend/executor/materializer argument and the live regression invokes exactly one participant trial per observed head.
interpretation: PASS qualifies the FMR-specific read-only same-trial observation API as a production-facing building block, not the E3/P4 coupling policy itself.
PASS makes the G14 fused integration shape implementable without duplicate physical trials while preserving participant ownership.
Generic participant abstraction, tangent service orchestration, and HCOF/RHS integration remain separate admission steps.
